authoringRule: Start from the full Director View. Shortlist with current metadata, resolve the exact asset in FULL_VISUAL_INDEX.json, then visually inspect its atlasPage and atlasSlot in the single CURRENT Visual Atlas PDF before any visual claim, asset choice or storyboard.
visualRule: The single CURRENT Visual Atlas PDF is the preferred pixel source. JPEG pageImageUrl sheets remain transport/debug fallbacks only. Never infer appearance from names or metadata.
atomicRule: Verify publishTransactionId, catalogRevision, snapshotContentHash, contractRevision and schemaHash as one atomic identity before authoring.
eligibilityRule: A missing preview does not prove a missing film asset. Check the eligibility audit and completion queue; flagged sample, generated or technical-looking records require Unity source review before preview generation.
animationRule: Use exact AnimationClip IDs with one representative image per animation family. Do not require every frame.
audioRule: Audio is a first-class non-visual Director input and must not be counted as a visual gap.
prefabRule: Prefab internals are not authoring vocabulary. Only safe CanonicalActor or PreviewSafeVisualComposite projections may be selected; gameplay scripts, colliders and physics remain hidden.
deboraRule: Debora opens deboraPageUrl, presses COPY FOR CHAT, pastes the message, and describes the cutscene. Her ChatGPT reads CURRENT itself and uses the single Visual Atlas for pixel inspection.
fallbackRule: If direct Pages or Visual Atlas access genuinely fails, use fallbackDirectorPackUrl. Never mix transactions or manually pair older packages.
